items.exampleEn: The kitten is sleeping in a box.
Parrots can live for more than fifty years.
items.exampleZh: 鸚鵡可以活五十年以上。

items.exampleEn: Humid air makes me feel tired.
items.exampleZh: 潮濕的空氣讓我覺得很累。

items.exampleEn: She picked a daisy from the garden.
items.exampleZh: 她從花園裡摘了一朵雛菊。

items.exampleEn: Misty mornings are common here in autumn.
items.exampleZh: 這裡秋天常有起霧的早晨。

items.exampleEn: Many kinds of animals live in the rainforest.
items.exampleZh: 許多種動物住在雨林裡。

items.exampleEn: The sea was stormy, so the boats stayed in the harbor.
items.exampleZh: 海上有暴風雨，所以船都停在港口。

items.exampleEn: Beavers have strong teeth for cutting wood.
items.exampleZh: 河狸有用來咬斷木頭的強壯牙齒。

items.sentenceEn: Our parrot loves to sing in the morning.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的鸚鵡早上很愛唱歌。

items.audioEn: It's hot and humid today, so remember to drink a lot of water.
items.audioZh: 今天又熱又潮濕，記得多喝水。
options: Drink a lot of hot tea.

items.sentenceEn: The mountains look beautiful on misty days.
items.sentenceZh: 山在有霧的日子看起來很美。
有些雨林正在快速消失。

items.stemEn: The meeting was ____: people shouted and argued for hours.
items.stemZh: 會議很激烈：大家吵了好幾個小時。

items.stemEn: A ____ is a bird that can copy the words people say.
items.stemZh: 鸚鵡是一種能模仿人說話的鳥。

items.passageEn: My cousin lives near a rainforest, and she often sends me emails. She says the air is very humid, and her clothes are always wet. One morning, it was so misty that she could hardly see the trees. Her neighbor has a colorful parrot that can say "Good morning!" Small flowers like daisies grow near her house. When the weather is stormy, she stays home with her kitten. Last week, she sent me a video of a beaver building its home in a river far away. It was incredible.
items.passageZh: 我表姊住在一座雨林附近，常常寄電子郵件給我。她說那裡的空氣非常潮濕，她的衣服總是濕濕的。有一天早上霧大到她幾乎看不見樹。她的鄰居養了一隻色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡，會說「Good morning!」。她家附近長著雛菊之類的小花。天氣風雨交加時，她就和她的小貓待在家裡。上週，她寄給我一段影片，是一隻河狸在遠方的一條河裡蓋家。那段影片真是精彩極了。

questions.questionZh: 有一天早上的天氣怎麼樣？
options: 陽光很強，大家都戴了帽子

questions.questionZh: 表姊上週寄了什麼給作者？

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："Last summer, my family visited a rainforest. The air was very humid, and our clothes were always wet. On the first morning, it was misty, and we could hardly see the trees. Our guide showed us a colorful parrot that could say \"Good morning!\" We also saw small flowers like daisies growing near the path. In the afternoon, the weather became stormy, so we went back to our hotel. There, a little kitten was waiting for us at the door. On our last day, we visited a river and saw a beaver building its home. It was an incredible trip."；改後："My cousin lives near a rainforest, and she often sends me emails. She says the air is very humid, and her clothes are always wet. One morning, it was so misty that she could hardly see the trees. Her neighbor has a colorful parrot that can say \"Good morning!\" Small flowers like daisies grow near her house. When the weather is stormy, she stays home with her kitten. Last week, she sent me a video of a beaver building its home in a river far away. It was incredible."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："去年夏天，我們全家去了一座雨林。空氣非常潮濕，我們的衣服總是濕濕的。第一天早上起了霧，我們幾乎看不見樹。導覽員給我們看了一隻色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡，牠會說「Good morning!」。我們也看到小路旁長著雛菊之類的小花。下午天氣變得風雨交加，所以我們回到飯店。在那裡，一隻小貓正在門口等我們。最後一天，我們去了一條河，看到一隻河狸正在蓋牠的家。那真是一趟令人難以置信的旅行。"；改後："我表姊住在一座雨林附近，常常寄電子郵件給我。她說那裡的空氣非常潮濕，她的衣服總是濕濕的。有一天早上霧大到她幾乎看不見樹。她的鄰居養了一隻色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡，會說「Good morning!」。她家附近長著雛菊之類的小花。天氣風雨交加時，她就和她的小貓待在家裡。上週，她寄給我一段影片，是一隻河狸在遠方的一條河裡蓋家。那段影片真是精彩極了。"
